steps.name: Dining in Cali (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Io] in “Gerda,” defeat [Echo] in “Fountain of Echoes” to obtain <Ice Wings of Binding>. Then report to [Medea] in Kali.

lines.text: (Io is standing with a blank expression, probably lost in thought.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … I really don't know.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, what do you mean you don’t know?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When I encountered the energy of destruction... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Let go of such blasphemous thoughts. I still get goosebumps just thinking about that time.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Does the spirit of water and ice give you goosebumps?
(Narin raises her arm and looks at those words.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Sorry, spirits can't give you goosebumps. But that's it. Did you call Adventurer? He's coming over there... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Io, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing special, I was watching Gerda. It's rare to see eyes like this. It's definitely a place you'll want to stay.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you for saying that you would like to continue staying at Gerda. That's really nice to hear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what were you talking about?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's not a big deal, it just reminds me of the time when I felt the energy of destruction... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's okay. No need to worry. Because I'm alive now. If you're okay, you'll be able to do other things well too.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, you say that again. Don't worry, you're doing well.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, thank you. There is only you... . Is it because you want to hear this?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Of course... . That's right. Still, I feel a little sad. Even though this body is by your side, you only found the bad things... . joy.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if you two tried to be friends, you both said you didn't like each other. And I couldn't enter the Well of Echoes, and I thought it was a bad spirit.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Okay, man.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I asked Mir for ingredients for your special food that grow on Elder Mountain, so let off steam.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If you say so, I will gladly accept it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you thought so now, right? This person and that spirit are so strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (shudder)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Surprisingly... . As expected, as Shinick said, it's good to make fun of her. Anyway, welcome back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I have a place to go with you. I have to go see Miss Medea for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on with Calien?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Something happened. Let's go together because you have to be there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I have to be there?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll go and talk to you. It's an obvious story, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will do as you say.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I need to find one thing before I go to Cali. Because if I come with you, I can see a different side of the Well of Echoes.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I need to be there too so I don't get lost in the Fountain of Echoes, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io is always busy. It's important work, so take care of it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, see you later.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. Stay healthy.

steps.name: Dining in Cali (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shainic] at the entrance to Kali village (passage from Adrika). And when the story is over, go back into “Kali” and report to [Medea].

lines.text: (Medea, who was staring blankly at the sky of Kali Village, closes her eyes. Merrymel, who was drinking tea together, looks at Medea with a puzzled expression.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Medea? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The solid barrier is becoming increasingly meaningless.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes? What are you saying?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Guests will come. Far away in the North Sea... .
(As soon as the word North Sea is mentioned, Merrymel is surprised.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Hey Io! Hey Io! Are you saying Io is coming?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oops… . Merrymel was not only a fan of Shinick, but also of Io.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Now even if I die, Yeohan… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … Merrymel, that kind of joke... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I'm sorry, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will greet you, so please wait.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes, yes!! %s is also here. hello? I am using the parts you gave me well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was also Merrymel. I'm glad you're using it well. Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, you are here too. Ah, you're here. Mr. Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Miss Medea, I'm sorry for coming suddenly. How have you been? It was a bit of a shame that I didn't see you last time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At that time… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know. i'll wait.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then please wait a moment. I would like you to deal with this child while I prepare the car. Oh, I have some coffee that Adkina gave me. How about that?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, okay. This kid's name was Merrymel, right?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Uh, uh, how!! Do you know my name?!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't be surprised. Medea told me a lot. There is a good, pretty, and talented child in the village, and I feel sorry for letting her stay in the village... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I never thought Medea would say something like that... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I saw you when you were a newborn, and you have grown up a lot. Come to Gerda with Miss Medea later. There are Kali people in our village too.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Can I really go? But is there a Kali tribe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess Io came here a long time ago...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, it's Titi... . I know Miss Medea. Thanks for the coffee.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merrymel and Titi are children who went missing a long time ago when our village came down to Adrika.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought he was dead because I didn't know the news, but I was really happy when I heard that he was staying in Gerda.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Titi will be fine, right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course, I eat well, sleep well, and take good care of my ice.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all thanks to Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, it's because TT is doing well. Oh, that's right. I brought something for Miss Medea.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's a blueberry that's most similar to the one in Cali Village back in the day, and it's a delicious fish that can be caught in the North Sea. Medea liked this, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Media, even though it was only for a moment, she looked excited...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And this… . Ah, Merrymel. Could you please step aside for a moment? How about having dinner together in the evening?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Okay, Io. Then, Mediah, %s, then please talk. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: He's a good kid. My sister will definitely call me.
(As Merimel steps away, Io takes out the ice wings she had taken from the ice chest.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Miss Medea, I want you to see this and tell me your story.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Before that, %s… , there is something I would like you to do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik will be approaching the village soon, so could you please deal with him outside for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you Shinik? Me?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik must not see the items that Io has taken out... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If Miss Medea says this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure what's going on, but I'll go and see Shinik. But how much can I have?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will come out when the time is right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll just take some time.
(On the road from Adrika to the entrance of Kali village, a person can be seen running at a speed almost as fast as light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, you are here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, you smell less now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? If it smells… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now the smell is going away. thank god… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, that smell... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You know it♡ There must be a story you heard from the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris mentioned it, but is it really related to that smell?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right. I can smell death whether I like it or not. The smell of Agashura was so strong that I wanted to cover my nose, but not you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's really annoying that Perse, who stayed in the Underworld, made me like that. That's all I can feel as I easily pass the border between life and death.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Phew… .
(Shaynick gives a lonely look in his eyes and then smiles.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry, the smell isn't that strong anymore♡ Just wash it well and you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But what are you doing instead of getting out of the way? I'm on my way to see Medea. Is Io in Kali Village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's going on? say. Otherwise, we could go to hell together right now♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It would be better to ask the two people coming over there rather than you.
(As Shaynik said, Io and Medea are walking from inside Kali Village.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, Io. I'm here. Hey, it's all good, but don't hug me. It's hot.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wow, what a waste.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, it was an unreasonable request, but thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, I asked %s to hold you for a moment.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay. Medea must have had something to do. Instead, I know it's because I'll come visit often♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … What is that thing that's stopping me?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's a trap set by Vice to make Shinick go on a rampage. To get to Avalon, you have to go through Deborah.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As soon as the day of preparation arrives and Shinick unnie comes to Deborah, she will go crazy.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Weiss threw a mix of binding and witch power into the wings of some evil spirit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So I asked %s to discover it and Miss Media to purify it. Behind the scenes, the binding power has weakened, but only Miss Medea can neutralize the witch's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch's power... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If my sister arrived in Kali before the purification was completed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … So, you asked me for Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you. And I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just because of me... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No. Because that's what I was going to do anyway.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I can't do it. Those bad guys, I’m going to send them all to hell and go too♡

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's do it together. I have to go to hell anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I heard you say things like that so naturally...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll wait♡

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll wait too. Ms. Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know that time is running out. I still have work to do... .
(As Medea continues speaking, her ears perk up.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Looks like the meal is ready. It became richer with the addition of ingredients brought by Io. Then please follow me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is it okay if I come in?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If it's not okay, will you go back to Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No♡ I’m going to have fun!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Miss Medea, you handle Shinic sister well... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Such nonsense... . %s, let’s go eat together. And I have something else to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Dining in Cali (3)
steps.objective: After talking with Medea in “Kali,” complete the quest to [Noel] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.text: (The blue wooden table is full of food from the Kali clan and dishes made with ingredients brought from Gerda. And the meal begins with Shinik holding the plate.)
(At the end of a special meal for guests after a long time, Medea hurries to send Merrymel away and speaks quietly to %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, please speak.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Adventurer, I would like you to visit a place nearby that may be your next destination.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's my next journey?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you can come and feel the energy of that place, it will help me in my work... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You may be able to disturb the One who gave you the message to wait for the night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He also told me... . A long-awaited night... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … Maybe he could have a bad influence on the goddess later... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where should I go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know where specifically, but I know who to go to.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you meet a Kali tribe person and approach the end as if led by fate, you may find the answer... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If anyone has figured out how to find the answer, please tell me about it. You can tell me everything you know, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this really okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Then, can I go visit Noel and Titi? Medea, why do you look at me like that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … The atmosphere has changed a little while we haven't seen each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's like the influence of a goddess. You've definitely gotten stronger... .
(Mediah shows a deeper smile than usual.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You don't have to worry about the amount of trust. The Kali clan trusts you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea. Then, I will go see Noel as soon as I have time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay, please… . Please say hello to Titi on your way there. I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I heard the whole story♡, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Stay still.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How can you keep me so bored♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I didn't have any expectations... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If a witch had appeared, there's no way I wouldn't know about it, but it's really fascinating. I've been messing around with Weiss here and there, but I've never really seen him.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He can hide his presence. Have you ever appeared as yourself? .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need to punish that rabbit witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Rabbit Witch?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, let's go to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think I should go see Noel.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just ask Noel if everything is alright, then go meet the next Kali person. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Oh, what are you going to do about Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Me? hmm… , How many more days are there in Cali? Hey, Miss Medea? Relax your expression. This is just something I tried,

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm going to the Valley of the Dragon to meet Adkina.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, Io. And I'll come back later, Medea. It's a shame I just left without even getting a taste of the barrier this time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We will prepare a stronger barrier to prevent such disappointing sounds. Oh my, you're already gone... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After all, it’s fun. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Shinik? Weren't you going with me? If you run like that first... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I just asked to go, but I didn't say 'together'.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. Then goodbye. I will go too.
(The two people disappear, and Io and Medea clear the table. Then, when their eyes meet, Io speaks quietly.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ms. Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What will Miss Medea do with Weiss when that day comes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As you wish... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm asking Miss Medea what she means.
